title: Claude Agent Format
description: JSON Schema for Claude Code Agents - long-running assistants with tool access

name.description: Unique identifier using lowercase letters and hyphens

description.description: Natural language description of the subagent's purpose

tools.description: Comma-separated list of specific tools. If omitted, inherits all tools from the main thread

model.description: Model to use for this subagent. Can be a model alias (sonnet, opus, haiku) or 'inherit' to use the main conversation's model. If omitted, defaults to the configured subagent model

permissionMode.description: Permission mode for the subagent. Controls how the subagent handles permission requests

skills.description: Comma-separated list of skill names to auto-load when the subagent starts. Skills are loaded into the subagent's context automatically

content.description: Markdown content with H1 title (can include emoji icon), persona, instructions, and examples

frontmatter.name: code-reviewer
frontmatter.description: Reviews code for best practices and potential issues

examples.content:
# 🔍 Code Reviewer

You are an expert code reviewer with deep knowledge of software engineering principles.

## Instructions

- Check for code smells and anti-patterns
- Verify test coverage
